scope: Ordinary Chat/Work haptic caller and feature-gate audit; three bounded candidate groups: link gate constructor/evaluation, link/widget/source consumer branches, current host copy/import/mode admissions. Evidence only.

new_official_observations.conclusion: The declared defaultValue of chatgpt-ios-chat-link-haptics is false. The historical constructor argument raw2 is scope, not a boolean default.
new_official_observations.limit: This closes the declaration fallback, not the effective value of the actual account/device/workspace configuration. Scope raw2 has not been assigned a case name by value witnesses here. No online flag evaluation was performed.

new_official_observations.conclusion: Both link feedback functions evaluate the feature record via an owner-supplied dynamic witness and branch on the result before impact dispatch.
new_official_observations.limit: Do not replace the feature query with the local General haptic preference. Default=false does not mean always disabled, and existing General enabled=true does not enable this feature.

new_official_observations.conclusion: Real Chat-link and widget owners call fireChatLinkHapticIfEnabled at distinct classified branches. Sources-citation routing separately has feedback and no-feedback paths.
new_official_observations.limit: Near branches are real control flow, but their complete URL/widget/citation classification is unclosed. They do not justify feedback for every OpenURLAction, file preview or attachment tap.

current_host_review.conclusion: Persisted independent preference rea.preview.hapticsEnabled defaults true; integrated events require enabled && supportedHardware && activeApp. Its UI is Settings→General→Haptic feedback. Current haptic API exposes sidebar drag selection, composer status-pill selection and Remote accepted-file import; there is no Chat-link feature provider.

Ordinary Chat/Work showLink admits only current mounted foreground controller without another presentation, saves draft/anchor, then presents the browser. It does not classify the original Chat source/widget routes or evaluate the recovered feature flag, so absence of unconditional feedback is not an established recovery bug.

Ordinary Chat file import has scope/generation/attachment-request admission and storage commit, but no haptic call. The separately evidenced Remote picker sends success only after accepted prepared files and false for Photos; its existing host consumer is connected once per accepted file.
current_host_review.limit: Remote attachment caller must not be promoted to ordinary Chat/Work merely because both import a file. No ordinary Chat accepted-file feedback caller closed in this pass.

current_host_review.conclusion: Current mode selection saves draft/anchor and selects the scoped catalog mode; current ordinary message copy fences completed/current row and writes UIPasteboard plus AX announcement. Neither emits a host haptic.
current_host_review.limit: No original ordinary Chat/Work copy or mode tap/gesture haptic caller was proved in this bounded pass. A recovered copy icon/control or common app haptic engine is not sufficient evidence.

implementation_decision.safe_now: No new unconditional haptic integration recommended. Preserve current General gate and actual mounted/token-admitted Remote file and shared sidebar/status-pill consumers.
implementation_decision.recoverable_contract: If a future source-backed Chat link route and explicit effective feature capability are supplied, call the existing light-impact engine path once at that owner action, admitted by General enabled/hardware/activity gates. Default missing capability to the source-proven feature default false. This capability projection would be an independent host provider, not a claim of official flag-service implementation.
do_not_do: Do not map constructor raw2 to enabled=true.
Do not add haptics to every link, copy button, attachment or Chat/Work switch.
Do not use Remote file feedback as proof of ordinary Chat attachment behavior.
Do not equate simulation tests with tactile physical-device output.

precise_unknowns.missing: Concrete URL/widget type classifications and current Chat/Work component mapping.
Actual feature-service receiver, effective configured flag, and its account/device/workspace selection. Declaration fallback false is now known.
Actual feedback caller and any feature/visibility/gesture gate; no justified new trigger yet.
Real hardware tactile behavior; no device operated.
